text: Every city has walks that hurt. Cold that bites through a coat. Sun with no shade for blocks. A station elevator that is out, with no warning.
happy map plans the walk by what you are exposed to, not only by how long it takes.
It is built for Toronto, on open data, and every claim in this video is measured.
Minutes outdoors in January. Metres of direct sun in July. Stairs, missing sidewalks, and subway elevators that are out of service right now.
Every route sits next to the fastest one, so the trade-off is never hidden.
Scotiabank Arena to the Eaton Centre: sixteen metres outdoors instead of eight hundred, for one extra minute.
Since the first of September, a server has logged every T T C elevator outage, every five minutes. The app is judged by that data, not by claims.
Open source, live today, and honest about what it cannot see yet.
